title: 🎉 The Sports Day Parade Mystery
intro: Whiskers, Luna, Oliver, and Bella are marching in the Sports Day parade, each showing off their favorite sport AND waving a favorite colored flag. Can you match every cat to both?
clues: Luna's sport is not Swimming, Soccer, or Basketball.
Bella's flag is not Red or Blue.
Whoever's flag is Yellow loves Basketball.
Whoever's flag is Green loves Soccer.
hints: Clue 2 rules out three sports for Luna all at once -- whatever's left over is her answer. Start there.
Clue 7 tells you Luna's flag directly: Blue. Mark that one with confidence!
Clues 4 and 5 don't name a cat -- they link a flag color straight to a sport. Once you know a cat's sport, check whether it matches either of those clues.
Clue 3 narrows Bella down to just two flag colors left. Try combining it with clue 5 (Green -> Soccer) to see which flag fits Bella.
Once Bella and Luna are settled, clue 1 and the leftovers sort out Whiskers and Oliver -- use clue 6 last to confirm Oliver's flag.
